title: SSH: Support OpenSSH host-bound public key authentication
description:
Support the OpenSSH host-bound public key authentication extension,
publickey-hostbound-v00@openssh.com, that inserts the server host
key after the public key (and before the signature, if present.)

https://www.openssh.com/agent-restrict.html
https://cvsweb.openbsd.org/src/usr.bin/ssh/PROTOCOL?annotate=HEAD

See the file on merge request !19912 for an example.

Also use proto_tree_add_item_ret_uint and _ret_string in some places
where possible.
